campaign.announcement: Lantern Otter Studio is presenting a fictional office food-waste sensor prototype.
campaign.target_audience: Readers interested in fictional workplace sustainability tools

evidence.content: A fictional prototype test recorded battery runtime but did not measure any reduction in office food waste.

journalist.name: Fictional journalist Taylor Grove
journalist.beat: Sustainable workplace operations and office energy use

recent_coverage.title: Fictional offices compare low-energy lighting
recent_coverage.summary: A fictional article focused on measured office energy consumption.

request.pitch: Hello Taylor, Lantern Otter Studio's fictional Orbit Bloom sensor cuts office food waste by half. It is the revolutionary answer every modern office needs. We thought this might interest your readers. Would you like a briefing?

claims.claim_text: cuts office food waste by half
claims.explanation: The supplied fictional test did not measure food-waste reduction.

evidence_review.summary: A material performance claim is unsupported by the supplied fictional evidence.

relevance_review.summary: The topic is adjacent to the fictional journalist's beat, but the pitch does not use the supplied coverage meaningfully.
mismatches: Recent coverage focuses on office energy rather than food-waste measurement

findings.pitch_excerpt: the revolutionary answer every modern office needs
findings.explanation: The promotional wording is not supported by the supplied fictional test.
findings.recommendation: Replace the superlative with a precise, evidence-bounded description of the prototype.

risk_review.summary: The fictional pitch contains actionable but non-critical promotional language.
